messages:
sophie.sales: Hey team — enterprise POC asking for SIEM/audit evidence. They want admin activity logs, retention details, delivery options (S3/Splunk), and sample schema. Can we share what’s public vs NDA-only?

priya.security: High-level control descriptions ok to share. For raw samples or anything with request/response ids we require NDA or redaction. We can provide synthetic logs that mirror schema and an encrypted-bucket sample policy.

alex.eng: For the POC we can enable admin-activity logs to object storage and stream to Splunk/Datadog via our connector. Defaults: hosted retention 90d; Dedicated can be configured to 1y+ per contract. All logs encrypted with KMS. Sample event below (redacted):
```json
{"event_type":"admin.login","user":"redwood-admin","timestamp":"2025-10-01T12:34:56Z","action":"grant_role","target":"project-REDACTED","ip":"203.0.113.5","request_id":"REDACTED"}
```

marco.ps: Customer asked whether model inputs are logged. Confirm?

priya.security: Model inputs are not logged by default. Logged telemetry includes request metadata, model variant id, token counts, latency, and operator/admin actions. If customer explicitly opts in to input logging we tag and treat those as sensitive and require contract controls.

sophie.sales: @priya.security please list the artifacts we can attach to CAIQ/SIG and a short blurb for vendor risk.

priya.security: Artifacts we can provide: 1) Control narrative describing logging, encryption, retention, and access controls; 2) Synthetic admin activity log JSON (redacted); 3) Example S3 bucket policy and KMS key usage notes; 4) Export config snippets for Splunk/Datadog. I’ll draft these and route through legal for NDA language.

alex.eng: Splunk HEC example (POC):
```bash
curl -X POST https://splunk.example/hec -H 'Authorization: Splunk <token>' -d '{"event":"..."}'
```

audIT-bot: VRR ticket created: VRR-5821 — Provide SIEM evidence for Acme POC (assignee: priya.security)

marco.ps: Can we stream real-time admin events into customer SIEM during the 30-day trial? Yes for Dedicated/Private. Hosted requires security review and enterprise enablement; add ~1 week to timeline.

sophie.sales: Customer wants trial with log forwarding. Any ops/cost blockers?

alex.eng: No infra blockers. For hosted forwarding we need approved config and a short runbook. Dedicated/Private straightforward once environment is provisioned.

priya.security: I’ll prepare the redacted artifacts by EOD and ping legal for the NDA. Once NDA is signed we can provide full, non-redacted samples including request/response ids.

sophie.sales: I’ll include this blurb in the proposal: "Admin actions are logged, immutable, encrypted, and retained per contract. Access is RBAC with MFA; audit trails are exportable to customer SIEM."

marco.ps: I’ll draft the POC runbook with steps to enable export, validate ingestion, and confirm retention settings. ETA 2 business days.

sophie.sales: Thanks everyone — will follow up after NDA is returned and customer confirms target SIEM (Splunk/Datadog/Sumo).
